## What it shows, and its limits

<!-- Differences, not causes; provenance, small groups, what the data can't
tell us. -->
- WRITE: The figure shows that 30-day readmission rates differ across racial groups and genders, but the figure only shows differences between groups and does not explain what causes those differences..
- WRITE: The data come from a hospital readmissions dataset, with each row representing one patient hospitalization. Some racial groups have smaller sample sizes (shown by the n values in the panel labels), so their rates may be less stable than those of larger groups. The data cannot tell us why readmission rates differ, whether any group was treated unfairly, or whether other factors such as age, health conditions, insurance status, or access to care influenced the outcomes.
